boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain California Polytechnic State University-San Luis Obispo
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe food stops in San Luis Obispo with directly documented service at 10 p.m. or later on at least one night.

cards.title: The All-Night Doughnut Counter
cards.subtitle: SloDoCo’s 24/7 Foothill Boulevard shop
cards.notes: Head to the Foothill Boulevard counter when other kitchens have closed; the official location page documents round-the-clock operation.
cards.short_summary: A purchase-required doughnut and coffee stop that remains available throughout the night near campus.
cards.evidence_claim: SloDoCo’s official contact page lists its 793 E. Foothill Boulevard location in San Luis Obispo as open 24/7.
cards.access_notes: Official hours are 24/7 at 793 E. Foothill Blvd., Suite F; confirm holiday exceptions before leaving.

cards.title: Doughnuts Until Midnight
cards.subtitle: SloDoCo’s second San Luis Obispo counter
cards.notes: Use the Higuera Street branch for a south-of-downtown doughnut run, checking the official page before any holiday-night trip.
cards.short_summary: A midnight-closing sibling to the 24-hour Foothill shop, with its own documented address and schedule.
cards.evidence_claim: SloDoCo’s official contact page lists its 195 Higuera Street location in San Luis Obispo as open from 5 a.m. to midnight.
cards.access_notes: Official hours are 5 a.m.–midnight at 195 Higuera Street; verify holiday hours before traveling.

cards.title: Foothill Pizza After Midnight
cards.subtitle: Carryout or delivery close to the Cal Poly side of town
cards.notes: Check the live store header, then choose carryout or delivery; this location page warns that hours and delivery areas can vary.
cards.short_summary: A nearby chain-pizza option whose official location page displays a live late closing time.
cards.evidence_claim: Domino’s official page identifies the 866 E. Foothill Boulevard store and reported it open until 1 a.m. when fetched.
cards.source_title: Domino's Pizza at 866 E Foothill Blvd | Domino's in San Luis Obispo
cards.access_notes: The live official store header reported service until 1 a.m. when fetched; recheck the page because hours vary by day and location.

cards.title: Downtown Pizza Until 1 A.M.
cards.subtitle: A Higuera Street dining room with seven-day late hours
cards.notes: Choose this downtown counter when the group wants pizza; Friday and Saturday extend one hour later than the rest of the week.
cards.short_summary: A downtown pizza restaurant documented to stay open until midnight daily and later on weekends.
cards.evidence_claim: Woodstock’s official contact page lists hours of 11 a.m.–midnight Sunday through Thursday and 11 a.m.–1 a.m. Friday and Saturday.
cards.source_title: Contact Woodstock's | Best Pizza & Craft Beer | 93401
cards.access_notes: Official hours: Sunday–Thursday until midnight; Friday–Saturday until 1 a.m. The page also flags occasional closure notices.

cards.title: Higuera Street Slices at Midnight
cards.subtitle: Pizza at 891 Higuera Street
cards.notes: Walk to the Higuera Street storefront for a late pizza order, but consult the direct ordering page before relying on midnight service.
cards.short_summary: A downtown pizza counter whose direct site currently lists service through midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Antonia’s Pizza’s direct website lists the restaurant at 891 Higuera Street and displays hours of 11 a.m.–midnight.
cards.source_title: Antonia's Pizza - San Luis Obispo, CA - 891 Higuera St - Hours, Menu, Order
cards.access_notes: The direct ordering site lists 11 a.m.–midnight; check its current Hours control before setting out.

cards.title: Broad Street Pizza Past Midnight
cards.subtitle: Late-week service at 2256 Broad Street
cards.notes: Save this Broad Street option for Thursday through Saturday, when the current ordering page shows its latest weekly service.
cards.short_summary: A pizza shop with documented midnight or 1 a.m. service in the latter part of the week.
cards.evidence_claim: The official ordering page for Round Table Pizza at 2256 Broad Street shows late-week hours reaching midnight in one service block and 1 a.m. in another.
cards.source_title: Round Table Pizza | 2256 Broad St #110, San Luis Obispo CA
cards.access_notes: Current page shows Thursday–Saturday until midnight for one service mode and until 1 a.m. for another; select carryout or delivery to verify.

cards.entity_name: Jack in the Box – 390 Santa Rosa Street
cards.title: The 4 A.M. Weekend Window
cards.subtitle: All-day breakfast and fast food on Santa Rosa Street
cards.notes: Check the lobby schedule before leaving; Thursday through Saturday run later than the location’s other documented nights.
cards.short_summary: A fast-food stop with official lobby hours extending to 2 a.m. most nights and 4 a.m. late in the week.
cards.evidence_claim: Jack in the Box’s official location page lists lobby hours until 2 a.m. Sunday through Wednesday and 4 a.m. Thursday through Saturday.
cards.source_title: Jack in the Box San Luis Obispo – 390 Santa Rosa St
cards.access_notes: Official lobby hours are 6 a.m.–2 a.m. Sunday–Wednesday and 6 a.m.–4 a.m. Thursday–Saturday.

cards.title: A Nearly 24-Hour Diner Table
cards.subtitle: All-day breakfast on Madonna Road
cards.notes: Use the official location page to confirm dine-in availability; its published schedule spans nearly every minute of every day.
cards.short_summary: A seated diner serving late-night breakfast fare under a nearly continuous weekly schedule.
cards.evidence_claim: Denny’s official page for 208 Madonna Road lists store hours from 12 a.m. to 11:58 p.m. every day.
cards.source_title: Denny's at 208 Madonna Rd, San Luis Obispo
cards.access_notes: Official store hours are 12 a.m.–11:58 p.m. daily; the page may show a slightly earlier online-order cutoff.

cards.title: Cookies at 3 A.M.
cards.subtitle: A late-night bakery at 22 Chorro Street
cards.notes: Check the day before ordering: the mapped storefront closes at 1 a.m. early in the week and extends to 3 a.m. Thursday through Saturday.
cards.short_summary: A bakery near campus with mapped late hours every night and a 3 a.m. closing on three nights.
cards.evidence_claim: Apple Maps lists Insomnia Cookies at 22 Chorro Street with closing times of 1 a.m. Sunday through Wednesday and 3 a.m. Thursday through Saturday.
cards.source_title: Insomnia Cookies in San Luis Obispo, CA – Apple Maps
cards.access_notes: Listed hours: Sunday 12 p.m.–1 a.m.; Monday–Wednesday 11 a.m.–1 a.m.; Thursday–Friday 11 a.m.–3 a.m.; Saturday 12 p.m.–3 a.m.

cards.title: Chorro Street Tacos Until 1 A.M.
cards.subtitle: Late-week Mexican food in downtown San Luis Obispo
cards.notes: Plan this run for Thursday through Saturday to use the 1 a.m. schedule; earlier weekdays and Sunday close sooner.
cards.short_summary: A downtown taqueria whose official site documents three consecutive nights of 1 a.m. service.
cards.evidence_claim: San Luis Taqueria’s official site lists its 1032 Chorro Street location as open until 1 a.m. Thursday, Friday, and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official hours: Monday–Wednesday until 10:30 p.m.; Thursday–Saturday until 1 a.m.; Sunday until 10 p.m.
